sections.headline: Background, grammar and active question
sections.summary: This theme combines the recorded long-range context CC02, Reality Grammar G2, and its paired baseline question Q2; none of the three is treated as a personality label. A useful expression is to distinguish background from demand: Limits define the range within which the runtime can form. The baseline runtime question is: What is worth trusting? If a baseline coordinate is treated as a fixed life verdict, the ECR reading becomes more certain than its authority supports.

whatWeSee: This theme combines the recorded long-range context CC02, Reality Grammar G2, and its paired baseline question Q2; none of the three is treated as a personality label. A useful expression is to distinguish background from demand: Limits define the range within which the runtime can form. The baseline runtime question is: What is worth trusting? If a baseline coordinate is treated as a fixed life verdict, the ECR reading becomes more certain than its authority supports.

The baseline question Q2 resolves to R2 as the primary capability in the versioned ECR question-capability matrix. When this capability is available, it can support the current demand by: Organizes recognition, interpretation and workable understanding. When the required capability is unavailable or overloaded, the same demand may remain unresolved even when the structural coordinate is clear.

All twelve driver identities remain present. The birth-coordinate baseline ranks D2 first by the ECR solar-anchor sector-distance rule; this is not a claim about the current Reality driver priority. The leading baseline driver can be read as an organizing tendency: Draws attention, resources or relationships toward an active field. Treating baseline affinity as a live priority can hide the effect of present constraints, feedback and resources.

The solar anchor resolves to motion M1 and environment-first configuration ECR-H08; the upper trigram is used as environment priority and the lower trigram as embodied response position. The change pattern can be read through the relation between surrounding field and embodied response: Change proceeds by holding, receiving and carrying what must remain together. The environment-priority configuration emphasizes containment in the surrounding field while the embodied response position emphasizes exchange. This is an ECR structural convention, not an I Ching fortune claim. If environment and response position are collapsed into one meaning, the environment-first distinction is lost.

cards.subtitle: A direction keeps drawing attention and investment
cards.oneLineInsight: Some directions keep returning not because they are fully understood, but because their attraction remains real.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: This card points to a persistent directional attraction. Even before the reason is fully understood, attention, curiosity, investment, or imagination keeps returning to the same direction. Calling does not prove that direction is correct; it means the theme is persistent enough to deserve observation and validation rather than dismissal.
cards.flowingExpression: When the calling increasingly aligns with real-world evidence, attraction can become clear direction and meaningful investment.
cards.strainedExpression: When calling is romanticized, persistent attraction can be mistaken for a guaranteed answer while practical conditions are ignored.

cards.title: WITHDRAWAL
cards.subtitle: The system narrows new input and connection to protect stability
cards.oneLineInsight: Protection can preserve stability, but when it keeps expanding it can also close off new input and possibility.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: This card describes a system reducing input, connection, and openness to avoid further load, conflict, or uncertainty. Some contraction can be protective, but if it keeps expanding, boundaries that once preserved stability can become restrictions that block new resources, relationships, information, or change.
cards.flowingExpression: When contraction is intentional and bounded, the core can be protected while preserving the ability to reopen later.
cards.strainedExpression: When withdrawal keeps expanding, the system can become increasingly dependent on existing structures even when new support or opportunities appear.

cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: This card describes a system reducing input, connection, and openness to avoid further load, conflict, or uncertainty. Some contraction can be protective, but if it keeps expanding, boundaries that once preserved stability can become restrictions that block new resources, relationships, information, or change.
cards.flowingExpression: When contraction is intentional and bounded, the core can be protected while preserving the ability to reopen later.
cards.strainedExpression: When withdrawal keeps expanding, the system can become increasingly dependent on existing structures even when new support or opportunities appear.
cards.observationPrompt: Which protective moves are still necessary, and which have begun to restrict useful new input?

cards.title: CONTAINER
cards.subtitle: Complex material needs a stable enough container
cards.oneLineInsight: Support may come not from more stimulation but from a space that can hold what matters.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: Environmental conditions of containment, holding, and keeping necessary structure together.
cards.flowingExpression: The environment can hold complexity without forcing immediate completion.
cards.strainedExpression: A container without boundaries can turn support into endless holding.
cards.observationPrompt: What kind of space helps you hold things steadily instead of constantly reacting?

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: Observe whether the surrounding field and your actual response are moving in the same way or in different ways.
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: What changes when the environment supports a different motion than the embodied response?

cards.title: CLOSURE
cards.subtitle: The current window is closing and approaching transition
cards.oneLineInsight: Closure is not emptiness; it makes room for another configuration.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: This card represents temporal closure in the ECR baseline window and an approach toward configuration transition.
cards.flowingExpression: Completion, release, and integration give the current runtime a clear exit.
cards.strainedExpression: Refusing closure can let a completed structure occupy capacity needed for the next cycle.
cards.observationPrompt: What now deserves a proper ending instead of being carried into the next cycle?

cards.title: FOCUS
cards.subtitle: Finding what deserves weight among many possibilities
cards.oneLineInsight: Not everything needs equal attention; this reading emphasizes what deserves weight.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: Attention and judgment are converging from many possibilities toward what deserves priority.
cards.flowingExpression: Knowing what deserves priority can reduce unproductive dispersion.
cards.strainedExpression: If every signal is weighted equally, the real priority can disappear.
cards.observationPrompt: What most deserves your full attention now?

cards.title: CALLING
cards.subtitle: A direction keeps drawing attention and investment
cards.oneLineInsight: Some directions keep returning not because they are fully understood, but because their attraction remains real.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: This card points to a persistent directional attraction. Even before the reason is fully understood, attention, curiosity, investment, or imagination keeps returning to the same direction. Calling does not prove that direction is correct; it means the theme is persistent enough to deserve observation and validation rather than dismissal.
cards.flowingExpression: When the calling increasingly aligns with real-world evidence, attraction can become clear direction and meaningful investment.
cards.strainedExpression: When calling is romanticized, persistent attraction can be mistaken for a guaranteed answer while practical conditions are ignored.
cards.observationPrompt: What direction keeps drawing your attention across different stages, and what real-world evidence supports continuing to explore it?

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: Compare the leading baseline driver with what actually receives attention and energy in the current situation.
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: Does the current Reality reinforce this driver, or has another driver become more important?

cards.title: DISCERN
cards.subtitle: Recognizing the distinctions that actually matter
cards.oneLineInsight: Understanding and discernment can turn mixed signals into clearer judgment.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: The capacity for recognition, interpretation, comparison, and workable understanding.
cards.flowingExpression: Understanding changes the frame, not just the amount of information.
cards.strainedExpression: Analysis without a stopping condition can deepen indefinitely without producing a usable judgment.
cards.observationPrompt: Which distinction, once clear, would change your understanding of the whole situation?
